The operating company and vendor directly providing **AppsFlyer** at **appsflyer.com** is **AppsFlyer Ltd.** (with U.S. and Canadian customers contracting through its subsidiary, **AppsFlyer Inc.**).

### Supporting Evidence
* **Site Terms:** *"AppsFlyer Ltd. (“AppsFlyer”, “Company”, “we”, “our” or “us”) welcomes you (“User” or “you”) to our primary website at www.appsflyer.com, and any of its sub-domains..."*
* **Services Privacy Policy:** *"AppsFlyer provides attribution and marketing analytics services (“Services“)... any reference to “AppsFlyer” “we” “us” or “our” shall mean AppsFlyer Ltd. and its affiliates."*
* **Legal Terms of Use (Section 16):** Specifies that contracting entities depend on customer domicile: *"if you are domiciled in the United States or Canada then you are contracting with AppsFlyer Inc... [otherwise AppsFlyer Ltd.]"*.
